phrase.text: The library is the set of functions the language brings: each has a fixed identity, a name in each profile and a signature that does not change with the language.

runs.text: No library name matches a reserved word, and library names are
reserved: a subprogram of your own with the same name hides the built-in one throughout the text.

points.text: Built-in functions by name; operations on a receiver.
Every symbol has an identity, names in both profiles and aliases.
The input, output, time and network families need capabilities.
